title: DECISION: CredentialStore always runs bcrypt::verify for unknown usernames (timing-attack prevention)
description: credentials.rs check() always runs bcrypt::verify even for unknown usernames using the pre-computed dummy_hash. This prevents timing-based username enumeration. The dummy hash is computed at the same bcrypt cost as the production hashes. A future contributor might add an early return for unknown users 'for efficiency' — this would create a timing oracle. Preserve this.
